newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EVERTON BOSS CHARGED WITH BRINGING GAME INTO DISREPUTE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON BOSS CHARGED WITH BRINGING GAME INTO DISREPUTE.

text.p: Everton manager Joe Royle was charged on Friday with bringing the game into disrepute -- the second English premier league club boss to be carpeted this week.
The English F.A. acted following Royle's heated comments to referee David Elleray after Saturday's league game against Blackburn.
Royle, a former England international, was furious over Duncan Ferguson's dismissal for dissent in the final minutes of the match.
Coventry boss Ron Atkinson is on a similar charge after incidents during his side's match against Chelsea in August.
